newsitem.title: SPAIN: Palma de Mallorca cargo traffic slips in August.
newsitem.headline: Palma de Mallorca cargo traffic slips in August.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Palma de Mallorca airport slipped to 1,960 tonnes in August from 2,032 in July, airport figures show.

Of the total, national cargo accounted for 1,516 tonnes while European Union traffic was 339 tonnes and international non-EU traffic 106 tonnes. The airport also handled 109 tonnes of mail in the month.
The August total takes accumulated cargo traffic so far this year to 12,542 tonnes.
Some 2.22 million passengers passed through the airport last month, compared with 2.05 million in July. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
